description:
We invest in our people and provide opportunities for you to grow with us. 
  
 Your experience and knowledge are our greatest asset. We are committed to helping you realize your individual potential and reach your personal goals. 
  
 We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. 
  
  
 What's the role? 
 As a Full Stack Infrastructure Engineer , you will be a key Agile team member building infrastructure components through traditional and infrastructure-as-code methods to support our web-based applications on premise and in the cloud.  
 You will: 
 Consult on right-sizing decisions for infrastructure and services 
 Provide functional analysis and oversight for incident management 
 Establish monitoring and automation processes to increase efficiencies 
 A strategic thinker, you move between diverse tasks with cooperation and persistence, helping to bring out the best in those around you. 
 
 Skills & Requirements Bring Your Best! What this role needs: 
 Minimum 2 years experience in Systems Administration or Systems Engineering.
Engineering standards and best practices 
 Ability to effectively communicate issues and solutions across all levels of the organization 
 Required Technical Experience: 
 Proven experience using containerization and software defined infrastructure.  Ideally this would include at least one or more of the following:  Docker, Kubernetes, or Vagrant 
 Experience with software development tools and continuous delivery and integration technologies.  Ideally this would include at least one or more of the following: Jenkins, Git based repositories, UrbanCode, or Nexus 
 Strong scripting abilities - for building tools to perform system automation activities. Ideally this would include at least one or more of the following: Ansible, Perl, Python, or Unix Shell 
 Detailed knowledge of web servers and middleware technologies. Ideally this would include at least one or more of the following: Apache, Nginx, Node.js, IBM WebSphere, SpringBoot, or Mule 
 Experience in Linux server administration 
 Preferred Technical Experience: Experience with Java, Javascript 
 Familiar with Windows Server 
 
 
  
 Req ID: 9181 
 Position Type: Regular Full Time
 Education Experience: Bachelor's Desired
 Employment Experience: 6-8 years
 Licenses/Certifications: 
 FLSA Status: Exempt
 Posting Date: 04/05/2017
